children: International arrivals to Vietnam rose 18.4% year-on-year to a four-month high of 1.99 million in August 2026, accelerating sharply from a 6.6% growth in the previous month.
Arrivals from China increased 10.4% to 457,000, while Russian visitor numbers more than doubled to 137,000.
Meanwhile, visitors from South Korea fell 3.2% to 372,000.
In the first eight months of 2026, international arrivals to Vietnam totaled 15.9 million, up 14.4% from the same period a year earlier.

title: Vietnam Tourist Arrivals Rise to 4-Month High
